stem: A wall sensor reports stable temperature and RH, but three canopy-level sensors show a repeated warmer and more humid zone in one corner. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: The wall sensor proves the whole room is uniform
The spatial pattern should be investigated and verified before changing global setpoints
Average all readings and ignore location
rationale: A single wall sensor may not represent crop-zone conditions. A repeated localized pattern warrants verification of placement, calibration and local environmental causes before global changes.
